property_summary: For every bytes32 assertionId the reference contract's getAssertionPolicy returns a struct with blockAssertion == false; the mutant flips blockAssertion to true for some assertionId values, so there exists an assertionId where calling getAssertionPolicy returns blockAssertion == true (violating the invariant).
change_summary: Change returned AssertionPolicy to block assertions (set blockAssertion to true) instead of false.
